label: Bagpipe chanter, sampled, close and dry
audition_title: libsonare bagpipe vs the sampled reference
_notes: Every 3th semitone across the compass this program is probed on, 62 to 74. Both ends were rendered before the grid was written and both speak, the peaks running 0.140, 0.142, 0.142 at the low, middle and high probe notes.
_velocities: Five. Velocity is the pluck or the mallet rather than a volume control, so it moves the partial stack as well as the level: on this slot velocity 32 sits -9.5 dB under velocity 100 at the middle probe note.
_dry: Nothing to switch off, measured rather than assumed. Not one of the plugin's advertised parameters matches `reverb` with this rack loaded, and the render agrees: what follows is the instrument's own fall with no room behind it.
_stimulus: This slot holds rather than falls: it is still at its own level when the key lifts at three seconds, so the gate only has to outlast the metrics' sustain window and the tail only has to catch the stop.
_calibration: From `capture.py calibrate` on this rack, run against it rather than carried over. The settle is kept generous: the rack next to this one renders silence or a note seconds late at two seconds of settle, and a probe taken there read one instrument eighteen decibels quiet, so a settle that costs time is preferred to one that costs a measurement.
_timbres: One, and the ladder is monotone above it, so this capture cannot move the voice past `voiced` however complete its coverage. The rack holds one slot per GM program, so there is no second of this instrument in it to disagree with. What the reference buys is a measured target for `autofit` and `--diagnose` where the voice could previously only be fitted by ear.
_dimensions: The slot is a double reed fed by a bag. Its GM family is a plucked one and this voice is not: it holds rather than falls, so the three free-decay dimensions are excused with that measurement rather than gated on a flat line.
_dimensions_na: The exclusions as data, since a dimension argued only in prose reads as a gap. Coverage is read against `toneclass.canonical_dimensions`, so anything not gated here has to be argued here.

dimensions_na.stereo: the slot renders dual mono: the two channels are bit-identical, so the width is zero by construction rather than by voicing
dimensions_na.decay: the slot does not fall under a held key - it is still at its own level six seconds in - so the slope a free decay would have is not in this reference, whatever its GM family is called
dimensions_na.aftersound: there is no free fall to have a late stage, the level being held rather than decaying
dimensions_na.doubling: there is no free fall to have a prompt stage, the level being held rather than decaying

_identity: Which product this is captured from lives in the untracked sibling `bagpipe.local.json`. Everything here is the method; scoring, fitting and diagnosing read `reference/bagpipe.json`.
_slots: Slot identity is measured, never taken from a name or a position. This program answers on channel 14, rendered at its own three probe notes before anything else was written, reading 1.000 of its energy on the played key's series. The same renders are what say the slot is usable at all: four slots of these two racks are a cliff rather than a decay, reproducing bit-identically at a fifth of a second, and are not captured.
